AI-Augmented Data Analyst
About the role
As an AI-Augmented Data Analyst , you will make an impact by transforming complex data into actionable insights that support better decision-making across underwriting, claims, finance, and operational functions. You will be a valued member of the Data & Analytics team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, data engineers, and technology partners to deliver advanced analytics solutions that improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experiences.
This role combines traditional analytics expertise with emerging AI-assisted analytical techniques to accelerate insight generation while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, governance, and data quality.
In this role, you will:
+ Develop and optimize analytical solutions using Snowflake SQL and modern data analysis tools to support enterprise reporting and decision-making.
+ Perform exploratory data analysis on large structured and semi-structured datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers.
+ Build and maintain analytical datasets, data marts, and reporting assets that support business intelligence and advanced analytics initiatives.
+ Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business questions into measurable analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
+ Apply AI-augmented analytics techniques to improve data exploration, pattern recognition, and insight generation while ensuring results are accurate, transparent, and business-relevant.
+ Develop reports, dashboards, visualizations, and presentations that communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Implement data quality controls, validation routines, and reconciliation processes to maintain trusted analytical assets.
+ Document business rules, data lineage, analytical methodologies, and reporting logic to support governance and knowledge sharing.
+ Partner with data engineering teams to improve data availability, integration, performance, and analytic readiness.
+ Support ad hoc analytical requests related to portfolio performance, operational effectiveness, customer behavior, and business strategy.
+ Promote responsible, ethical, and compliant use of data and AI-assisted analytics technologies.
Work model
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants within the Eastern Time Zone (EST) . While Hartford, CT is the preferred location, qualified remote candidates located within EST will also be considered.
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
What you need to have to be considered
+ 6+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analysis, or related disciplines.
+ Strong expertise in Snowflake SQL, query optimization, and analytical data modeling.
+ Experience performing exploratory data analysis, trend analysis, statistical analysis, and business performance assessments.
+ Hands-on experience developing analytical datasets, reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
+ Experience working with structured and semi-structured data in cloud-based analytics environments.
+ Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, validation, and governance practices.
+ Experience collaborating with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven recommendations.
+ Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
+ Ability to work independently in a distributed team environment while managing multiple priorities.
These will help you stand out
+ Experience in the Property & Casualty Insurance industry.
+ Knowledge of underwriting, claims, policy administration, pricing, actuarial analysis, or insurance operations.
+ Experience with AI-assisted analytics, augmented analytics, or Generative AI-enabled analytical tools.
+ Familiarity with data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
+ Experience supporting regulatory reporting, operational performance measurement, and executive reporting initiatives.
+ Knowledge of cloud data platforms and modern analytics architectures.

Posting Description
SENIOR DATA ANALYST AND REPORTING SPECIALIST, Sloan Office of External Relations (OER), supports development priorities through reporting, analysis, and business process improvement, with a primary focus on the MIT Sloan Annual Fund. The role develops and maintains reports, dashboards, datasets, and analytical outputs that support annual giving performance, donor behavior analysis, segmentation, campaign execution, portfolio and pipeline visibility, and related management reporting. Responsibilities include interpreting fundraising data, identifying trends and opportunities, improving reporting practices, supporting business definitions and process consistency, and contributing to development-focused projects. The role partners with OER colleagues and central Advancement teams to provide accurate, reliable, and useful decision support while strengthening broader development analytical capacity over time.
The full job description is available here: https://web.mit.edu/sloan-hr/jobs/OERSeniorDataandReportingAnalyst.pdf
Job Requirements
REQUIRED: Bachelor’s degree; a minimum of seven years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence, experience in higher education, advancement, nonprofit fundraising, or a CRM-driven environment preferred; strong SQL skills and experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Tableau, Cognos, Salesforce CRM Analytics, Power BI, or similar platforms; experience producing recurring and ad hoc reports, analyzing complex datasets, troubleshooting discrepancies, and translating business needs into analytical outputs and process improvements; strong communication, judgment, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities. PREFERRED: Experience with fundraising systems such as Advance, Salesforce, Blackbaud, or similar platforms; and familiarity with donor segmentation, campaign analysis, portfolio reporting, pipeline analysis, or revenue forecasting.

As a Data Analyst in the Finance Data Analytics department, you will be responsible for maintaining, improving, and building new reporting capabilities for cross-functional areas of the business. By developing a deep understanding of operational processes and needs, you will be responsible for implementing new reporting capabilities and using technology to deliver impactful reports. You will partner with teams in various functional areas of the business to implement process improvements that will streamline the efficiency and accuracy of the reporting process. You will be responsible to delivering daily, weekly, and monthly reports accurately and on time. You will also be involved in ad hoc analysis of large datasets to quickly provide insight into the business. Functional Support Area: Procurement/Accounts Payable/Accounts Receivable/Support Services Core Responsibilities • Function as an analytics and reporting expert for assigned functions by executing standard reports and, running / maintaining ad hoc queries. • Participate in the development of reports, metrics, models, scorecards, and dashboards by gathering data and transforming it into stories and insights that drive business recommendations and decision-making. • Publish daily, weekly, and monthly reports accurately and on time • Build reports and dashboards in Microsoft Power BI, Analysis for Office, Bex, and other reporting tools • Participate in hosted training sessions on how to use the various tools and reports created by the department • Generate load files for various systems, maintaining system accuracy • Communicate effectively with report stakeholders to ensure strong understanding of the methodology behind all calculations • Perform ad hoc analysis using data from various systems and explain results of analysis to all levels of management • Create SOPs and maintain documentation for processes • Demonstrate continuous efforts to improve processes, increase data integrity, and provide quality customer service to our business partners. • Provide comprehensive analytical and fact-based reporting to support and/or identify opportunities to impact operational results, make changes to processes, and support strategic initiatives. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. May perform other duties as assigned.
